files.description: Main EHI export landing page describing the three export mechanisms: FHIR API, CCDA, and CSV billing export. This is the registered (b)(10) documentation URL.

Comprehensive FHIR R4 API documentation — single-page doc covering 24 resource types with list/get/search operations, OAuth/SMART authentication, Bulk Export API, and CCDA export API. The primary technical documentation for the clinical data export.
Resource center page for creating and managing encounters. Contains the 'Export' section documenting how to export encounters as PDF, HL7 CCDA, or Surveillance Report from the EHR UI.
Screenshot of the CharmHealth encounter list showing the '...' (More Options) menu with bulk export options: Export Encounters as PDF, Export Encounters as PDF (New), Export Encounters as HL7 CCDA.
Screenshot of the CharmHealth encounter view showing the per-encounter Export button dropdown: Encounter as PDF, Encounter as HL7 CCDA, Surveillance Report - Registration, Encounter as PDF (New).

Resource center page documenting billing reports: invoices/receipts, payment reports, A/R aging, encounter summaries, and more — all exportable as CSV. Linked from the EHI export page as the mechanism for billing data export.
Resource center page for analytics including the Patient Insurance Report, which is exportable as CSV. Linked from the EHI export page for insurance data export.

Comprehensive resource center page documenting claims management: claim creation, submission, ERA processing, claims reports, denied procedures, and provider reports. Claims data is exportable as CSV. Linked from the EHI export page for claims data export.
Resource center page documenting how to export encounters as HL7 messages for use with external billing systems. Found as a navigation link in the billing section.
Full-page browser screenshot of the main EHI export documentation page.
Browser screenshot of the FHIR API documentation page top section showing navigation sidebar and introduction.
Browser screenshot of the Bulk Export section of the FHIR API documentation.

Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the FHIR API documentation HTML and extracts structured JSON with all 24 resources, 68 operations, parameters, OAuth scopes, Bulk Export, and CCDA details.

Enrichment output: structured JSON extraction of the entire FHIR API documentation. Contains all resource definitions, operations, parameters, OAuth scopes, Bulk Export API details, and CCDA API details. 24 resources, 68 operations, 0 parse failures.
README for the enrichment directory with run commands, input/output descriptions, and known limitations.
